# OpenCode 1.18.31 tool text

The tool descriptions of OpenCode v1.18.31 (commit `014614d35b397775e5d397a490fc72368c894ec2`),
copied unchanged from `packages/opencode/src/tool/`: every `*.txt` and
`shell/prompt.ts`, saved as `shell/prompt.ts.txt` so `node --test` does not
run it. They are OpenCode's work under the MIT License in
`LICENSE` beside them. `test/compact-tools.test.mjs` reads them to check
that `opencode-1.18.31-tool-safety.json` lists every safety clause the
compact tool text must keep. On an OpenCode pin move, copy the new
version's files here and re-derive the safety fixture
(`patches/README.md`, "Moving the OpenCode pin").
